heroHeadline: Former Erdoğan Adviser Ertan Aydın Arrested as Fund Probe Reaches the Ruling Party's Orbit
heroSubtitle: Ertan Aydın, architect of the AKP's 'Türkiye Yüzyılı' campaign, was arrested on Oct 25 in the investment-fund investigation after prosecutors overturned his house arrest; 15 of 22 suspects were remanded. Meanwhile the dissolved PKK said on Oct 8 it had withdrawn all fighters from Türkiye.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets (AP, Reuters, BBC, Washington Post, Euronews, Foreign Policy, Balkan Insight, Turkish Minute, Türkiye Today), Socialist International statements, and US State Department readouts.
